text:
Stop being so serious all the time. It's costing you more than you realize.

A man who can't laugh at himself looks fragile.

Women want a man secure enough to joke. Secure enough to be human.

Today: add one joke about yourself in your next conversation.

The man who laughs at himself owns the room.
caption:
Success in dating starts with men who can laugh at themselves without apology. It's a mindset shift. Send this to a man who needs it today.
#dating #success #mindset #discipline #selfimprovement
